text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! This is incredible! I can't believe
you were
able to scout so many talented
ponies!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You might have a real knack for
producing plays.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No need to be humble. Hark—can't you
hear?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The audience is cheering loudly for your
skilled
direction.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's time for the curtain call! Hold
hands,
everyone. The curtain is rising!
